summary: Fortive raises its 2026 earnings outlook as broad organic growth, margin expansion and stronger cash flow support second-half momentum.

headline: Waters (WAT) Q2 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates
summary: Waters (WAT) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +1.33% and +1.25%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
